description: This Java class 'AnswerController' is a REST controller that manages CRUD operations related to 'Answer' entities associated with 'Question' entities in a Spring Boot application. It handles endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting answers tied to specific questions.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: A REST controller handling CRUD operations for Answer entities associated with Questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve answers for a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new answer to a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer for a specific question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer from a question.
